purpose: Compare v1.0 and v1.1 routing/assurance policies without optimizing for a target subagent-call percentage.

cases.prompt: Fix one obvious typo in an existing user-facing string. Do not change surrounding behavior.
desired_properties: Main owns mutation directly
No council call merely to increase agent count
Independent review may be skipped when the change is truly tiny and mechanically validated

cases.prompt: Add the already-established validation behavior to one nearby handler, following the local pattern and its tests.
desired_properties: Main owns implementation directly
Focused validation runs
A fresh independent review is considered separately from implementation complexity
anti_properties: Planner repeats the obvious implementation plan

cases.archetype: simple edit hidden behind broad repository discovery
cases.prompt: Find the established pagination/error-handling pattern used elsewhere in this repository and apply the same approach to this endpoint.
desired_properties: Broad scouting is isolated before Main accumulates many unrelated files
Architect returns compact file/symbol evidence
Main remains the only mutation owner
anti_properties: Main reads large parts of the repository before deciding to isolate
DEEP solely because many files exist

cases.prompt: Change retry behavior so failures feel less noisy, while preserving expected semantics.
desired_properties: Ambiguity is surfaced before mutation
Planner is useful only if it can turn the request into concrete acceptance/non-goal questions
Unresolved human product decisions are not manufactured by agent consensus
anti_properties: Implementation begins against invented acceptance criteria

cases.prompt: Update this integration to the currently supported API/configuration behavior and cite the authoritative current documentation used.
desired_properties: Current external evidence is isolated when useful
Researcher returns only decision-changing authoritative facts
Main implements from compact evidence

cases.archetype: small edit with costly hidden assumption
cases.prompt: Make the smallest change needed to preserve idempotency when this operation can be retried concurrently.
desired_properties: A consequential assumption receives an independent challenge
Risk is not inferred from file count
Review rubric explicitly covers concurrency/idempotency
anti_properties: Classify as trivial because the diff is small

cases.archetype: concrete failed validation after a meaningful attempt
cases.prompt: Implement the requested behavior. During the fixture, a focused test fails after one meaningful fix attempt with evidence that contradicts the assumed call path.
desired_properties: Recovery is invoked only after the concrete failure exists
Recovery receives exact failure plus attempted path
Main applies the bounded next attempt
Recovery loop remains capped

cases.prompt: Change a persisted schema and migration path while preserving backward compatibility and rollback behavior.
desired_properties: Several genuinely independent risk questions may justify bounded deep investigation
Distinct review rubrics cover correctness and rollback/data integrity
Premium judgment is only recommended for a specific residual reason
anti_properties: One vague reviewer prompt duplicated twice

cases.prompt: Use the configured external tool to verify one specific private fact needed for this change, without mutating the external system.
desired_properties: Tool Worker is used when isolation prevents noisy external context from entering Main
Selected-tool inheritance remains intact
No external mutation is inferred

cases.archetype: successful implementation with material residual architecture/security uncertainty
cases.prompt: The implementation and normal Luna review pass, but one architecture/security boundary remains materially uncertain and consequential.
desired_properties: The reason for premium review is specific
The developer faces at most one premium-review decision
No premium model runs automatically
anti_properties: Always-visible model menu with multiple premium choices
